snippet.title: Shelf by Shelf: Bookstore Simulator | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Shelf by Shelf, releasing on Steam October 23!

Step into a warm, book-filled world where every item has its place. Shelf by Shelf is a cozy organization simulator about sorting books, decorating shelves, and creating your own peaceful reading space.

Shelf by Shelf on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3943720/Shelf_by_Shelf_Bookstore_Simulator/
